explanation: It was billed as an International Winter Sports Week and recognized as the first Winter Olympics only afterwards. St Moritz hosted the second, in 1928.

claims.text: The first Winter Olympics were held at Chamonix, France, in 1924.
St Moritz hosted the Winter Olympics in 1928 and 1948, Lake Placid in 1932 and 1980, and Oslo in 1952.
The 1924 Chamonix event was held as an International Winter Sports Week and was recognized by the IOC as the first Winter Olympics afterwards.
